messages:
maya: Quick check — Tuesday group lunch poll! Vote with emoji: :taco: tacos, :sushi: sushi, :salad: salad, or :fridge: heat-and-eat from fridge. I'll place the order at 11:45.
liam: Any allergies/diets? I'm GF.
devon: Can do sushi or salad. Tacos might be OK if they use corn tortillas.
sasha: Corn tortillas are fine — :taco: from me.
emma: Veg here, :taco: (no meat) or :salad: works.
lunch-bot: Poll created — react with :taco:, :sushi:, :salad:, or :fridge:. Voting window 20m.
liam: :taco: (gluten-free)
devon: :sushi: — can we get brown rice please?
maya: Noted, will add brown rice option. Current quick tally: tacos 3, sushi 1, salad 1.
sasha: Also +1 for extra guac :raised_hands:
maya: Ordering at 11:45 then — I'll DM for payments. If anyone has special requests drop them here.
devon: I'll Venmo for mine.
emma: I can Venmo too, thanks for organizing! :heart:
maya: Cool — order finalized: tacos (veg options included) + sushi brown rice request. See you at noon!
